cards.issue_title: Other charges has no drawer that calculates extra money for one missed EMI
summary_4_lines: On Explore banks, Other charges, overdue and EMI bounce show only static rates and rupee fees.
They said every other charge needs a drawer with a calculation inside, not just a yearly percent.
They want the extra money for a month if one EMI is missed, including the bounce fee, by clicking the underlined charge.
They said some banks charge about 24% and one miss can mean taking out double money.
cards.pinpoint: On Explore banks Other charges, overdue and EMI bounce values are not clickable calculation drawers, so a user cannot see extra rupees for one missed EMI including bounce.

cards.on_screen_object: Other charges table cells for Overdue charge and EMI bounce charge (and the Notes drawers under the table)
quotes_sample: For every type of audio charge, I need a drawer and I need a calculation in the drawer.
And I need to know the underlines. I need to click them and do the calculations.
If one EMI is missed for a month, we need total extra money.
related_discussion_one_liners: Tied the missing calculation to bank choice: even if another bank is 0.1% cheaper on interest, do not take a bank where one missed EMI means withdrawing double money.
That warning is also part of the intelligence; ranking/labeling is written as a separate issue (issue-02).
They said "Interest rate is extraordinary" while still on this table — a slightly better rate is not the whole story next to overdue/bounce.
They wanted the same underline-click pattern they already use for some range links (DCB overdue, Union Bank rate-change range).

Previous recording wb-rec-260816-0013 already attacked the overdue percent as "annum" that does not show next month’s total; this recording adds the drawer, the underlines, and bounce in the same total.
cards.distinct_from_other_files_in_this_folder: This is the missing clickable calculation drawer on Other charges overdue and EMI bounce cells; issue-02 is bank-row labels for lowest vs highest EMI-miss penalty, not the cell calculator.

cards.issue_title: Banks are not labeled as lowest or highest EMI-miss penalty
summary_4_lines: On Explore banks Other charges they said banks need labels for EMI-miss penalty, not only raw overdue and bounce numbers.
They named Jammu and Kashmir Bank as among the lowest penalty and IndusInd Bank as among the highest.
They said that ranking must be told to the site’s intelligence, even before someone takes a loan.
A bank that is 0.1% cheaper on interest should still be rejected if one missed EMI costs double.
cards.pinpoint: On Explore banks Other charges, bank rows are not labeled as lowest or highest EMI-miss penalty, and that ranking is not fed to the product intelligence.

related_discussion_one_liners: The extra-money drawer and clicking overdue/bounce underlines belong to issue 01; they are the mechanism, this issue is the bank-level label/intelligence.

They said "Interest rate is extraordinary" between the label talk and the overdue/bounce calculation talk — rate alone is not the ranking they want.
